title.zh: 无颌鱼类来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Agnatha to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开无颌鱼类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Early fishes time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的早期鱼类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open the Silurian–Early Devonian Heterostraci study-matrix window to inspect age-routed sampled occurrence context; this is an evidence inspection aid, not a complete clade history.
description.zh: 打开志留纪至早泥盆世异甲鱼研究矩阵窗口，检查按年代路由的采样出现背景；这是证据检查入口，不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The 443.8–393.3 Ma interval follows the dated taxa included in the Randle et al. study matrix; it is a stage-bound study-sample envelope, not a global Heterostraci FAD or LAD.

Map markers reflect sampled localities, specimens and occurrence coding in that matrix; incomplete locality and taxon sampling do not support a complete distribution, direct ancestry or an unsampled interval.

description.en: Open the Silurian–Devonian Osteostraci sampled-genera window to inspect an age-routed morphology-matrix context; the plotted interval is not an exact clade origin or extinction.
description.zh: 打开志留纪至泥盆世骨甲鱼采样属窗口，检查按年代路由的形态矩阵背景；所示区间不是精确的类群起源或灭绝时间。

limitations: The 433.4–358.9 Ma interval is the stratigraphic envelope of sampled genera in Sansom’s morphology matrix; it is not a global Osteostraci FAD, LAD or continuous lineage duration.
Map markers and matrix observations are bounded by the represented specimens and localities; unsampled occurrences, complete distribution and direct ancestry remain unresolved.

description.en: Open the rounded Famennian Waterloo Farm window for the Priscomyzon holotype to inspect its source-bounded locality and age context on the map.
description.zh: 打开 Priscomyzon 正模标本在圆整法门期 Waterloo Farm 的窗口，在地图中检查其有来源边界的地点与年代背景。

limitations: The 360–359 Ma values are a rounded time-scale envelope for holotype AM5750 from the Famennian Witpoort Formation at Waterloo Farm, Eastern Cape, South Africa; they are not a direct numerical date or global species range.
The map represents one named specimen and locality; its sampled occurrence cannot establish a complete distribution, crown-lamprey FAD, lifecycle, behaviour or direct ancestry.

title.zh: Myxinikela 莫斯科期标本窗口

description.en: Open the rounded Moscovian Francis Creek Shale window for the Myxinikela specimens to inspect their source-bounded locality and age context on the map.
description.zh: 打开 Myxinikela 标本在圆整莫斯科期 Francis Creek Shale 的窗口，在地图中检查其有来源边界的地点与年代背景。

limitations: The 310–307 Ma values bound holotype FMNH PF15373 and paratype FMNH PF8472 from the Moscovian Francis Creek Shale, former Pit 11, Illinois; preservation differs between specimens and the interval is not a direct numerical date or hagfish range.
The map shows a bounded specimen locality and does not establish a broader distribution, crown-Myxini FAD, modern hagfish ecology or direct ancestry.

title.zh: Tethymyxine 森诺曼期化石库窗口

description.en: Open the rounded Cenomanian Hâdjoula Lagerstätte window for Tethymyxine to inspect its single-holotype locality and age context on the map.
description.zh: 打开 Tethymyxine 单件正模标本在圆整森诺曼期 Hâdjoula 化石库的窗口，在地图中检查其地点与年代背景。

limitations: The 100.5–93.9 Ma values are a Cenomanian stage envelope for holotype BHI 6445 from the Hâdjoula Lagerstätte, Lebanon; one complete body fossil does not provide a direct numerical date or global crown-Myxini FAD.
The map represents one sampled locality and specimen; it cannot establish a complete distribution, uninterrupted range, direct ancestry or an inferred diet and behaviour.

description.en: Compare tujiaaspis and xiushanosteus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较tujiaaspis与xiushanosteus；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.
